title: Verify deadline during EUR replay execution
changes: Record a bounded DBG2-15 server deadline while a real interpreter replay is executing guest frames.
validation: A copied EUR DS-20 worker reported running at 9/102 frames. The client reported an unacknowledged timeout at the 1400 ms deadline; the later server result for the same request reported timeout with no pending request and the same worker interrupted at 13/102. The paused parent state, frame and clock, source profile, protected inputs and session pins remained unchanged; session and display closed.
limitations: This covers one Wine/interpreter replay and does not prove the complete assistant procedure, all parity, native Windows or physical input.
